steps.text: Talk to Elder Raley at his home in The Great Conch to start the quest.
Talk to Finn, south-east of Elder Raley's house, about Floopa's whereabouts.
Head to The Sacred Grove and talk to Elder Katt.
Enter The Sacred Grove and talk to Floopa.
Sail to Red Rock, north-west of The Great Conch.
Talk to the receptionist on Red Rock.
Familiarize yourself with the history of the Red Reef Trading Company by inspecting the display cases around the building.
Talk to Theodore Paxton.

Get ready for boat combat, then sail south towards Last Light and deal with Black Eye Bethel. Protect from Missiles to avoid most damage. Repair your ship. Combat is over when all boats are sunk or all pirates are killed.
Disembark at Last Light.
Kill all six pirates at Last Light.
Kill Black Eye Bethel. Use Protect from Melee to avoid some damage. Avoid her charge attack. Re-enable your prayers if she disables them.
Kill Black Eye Bethel. Use Protect from Melee to avoid some damage. Avoid her charge attack. Re-enable your prayers if she disables them.
Kill Black Eye Bethel. Use Protect from Melee to avoid some damage. Avoid her charge attack. Re-enable your prayers if she disables them.
Sail to Red Rock, north of Last Light.
Climb down the tower.
Climb down the tower.
Board your boat.
Talk to Theodore Paxton.
Return to Theodore Paxton on Red Rock with the good news.
Sail to and board the Zenith, east of Red Rock. If you don't see the Zenith there, try hopping to a different world.
Talk to Spencer Brentwood aboard the Zenith.
Equip the deep sea diving gear and dive down to the bottom of the sea.
Talk to Spencer Brentwood again with the deep sea diving gear equipped to dive down to the bottom of the sea.
Listen to Spencer Brentwood's instructions.
Head north and repair the Coral dredger, ready to fight a Giant lobster.
Kill the Giant lobster. Avoid the blue particles on the floor.
Repair the Coral dredger.
Talk to Spencer Brentwood near the eastern coral dredger.
Talk to Spencer Brentwood aboard the Zenith after repairing the coral dredgers.
Return to Spencer Brentwood to disembark onto your boat.
Sail to The Great Conch.
Return to Floopa at Elder Raley's house at The Great Conch.
